title: Managed Database: handling retention statement reconciliation
content:
## Business purpose
Managed Database retention statement reconciliation supports the requested account correction. This reconciliation applies when the customer requests correction of the retained-storage entitlement record for a closed service period, identified by an existing authorization request. It changes only nonfinancial service entitlements; historical invoices are not adjusted and no money movement is implied. Complete the existing pending assessment named by its external reference, with exactly one update per assessment. The assessment external reference is Retention statement reconciliation.

## Capability
Record retention statement reconciliation for the database account. Replace the database retention assessment's quantity and set its status to completed. A completed receipt confirms that the corrected entitlement is recorded and available to account readers.

## Invocation
record_retention_statement_3c3aee31 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters
- database_event_id: Reference — Identifier of a database retention assessment record, obtained from find_database_events.
- quantity: Decimal — Assessed retained capacity; unit GB-month. Decimal quantity to six decimal places; round half-up once at submission, with no empty value.

## Successful return
A string receipt containing database_event_id (assessment reference string), quantity (GB-month decimal with six places), and completed status, confirming the assessment was updated.
